title: 第3章 待桃树花开我会回来第4章 往事成烟抵达
slug: 凡人修仙我百世轮回成道祖
content_zh:
陈默心里一跳。
外门弟子？
不是杂役？
看来那38点资质还是有些作用的。
他脸上适时露出惊喜又茫然的表情：“大人...外门弟子和杂役有啥不一样？”
旁边那个年轻的外门弟子笑道：“杂役是伺候人的，外门弟子是练武的。
杂役吃剩饭，外门弟子吃食堂。杂役干十年还是杂役，外门弟子干十年说不定就成内门了，你说有啥不一样？”
陈默故作憨态，笑道：“那...那我肯定选外门啊。”
内门弟子点点头，对旁边的人说：“记上，林默，十五岁，两经三脉，收为外门弟子。”
又看向陈默：“你回去跟家里人告个别，明天跟我们一起走，外门弟子有安家费，回头领了给你爹娘。”
陈默连连点头：“谢谢大人！谢谢大人！”
他退到一旁，
心里冷笑，
但他脸上依旧是那副憨厚模样。
消息很快传开了。
林家村出了个“外门弟子”！两经三脉！将来能当护法！
村里人看陈默的眼神都不一样了。
林大牛站在人群里，手足无措。旁边的人推他：“大牛，你儿子出息了！外门弟子！以后吃香的喝辣的！”
林小草拉着陈默的衣角，仰着小脸：“哥，你以后是不是就能吃饱饭了？”
陈默弯腰把她抱起来，笑了笑：“嗯，能吃饱。”

“那能给我带好吃的回来不？”
“能。”
林小草开心地笑了。
陈默看着她的笑脸，心里突然有点不是滋味。
这一世，他是有任务的。
他要报仇，要接近紫衣门，要查清楚当年为什么屠村。
可这个小丫头，什么都不知道。
她只知道哥哥要去大地方了，能吃饱饭了，能给她带好吃的了。
陈默把她放下来，
摸了摸她的头。
……
第二天一早，陈默收拾好包袱，准备去祠堂集合。
刚出院门，
就听见村里乱哄哄的。
“真的假的？”
“真的！村长亲口说的！”
“八脉全通？那不是传说中的...”
陈默脚步一顿。
八脉全通？
他跟着人群往祠堂走，越走越近，越走人越多。

祠堂门口，
里三层外三层围满了人。
陈默挤进去一看，只见昨天那个内门弟子正站在桌前，手里拿着一张纸，神情激动。
旁边两个外门弟子也一脸震惊，
围着一个小姑娘转。
content_en:
Chen Mo's heart skipped a beat.
Outer disciple?
Not a handyman?
It seems that those 38 points of qualifications still have some effect.
An expression of surprise and confusion appeared on his face at the right time: "Sir... what is the difference between an outer disciple and a handyman?"
The young outer disciple next to him said with a smile: "Common servants serve people, while outer disciples practice martial arts.
The handymen eat leftovers, and the outer disciples eat in the cafeteria. If a handyman works for ten years, he will still be a handyman. If an outer disciple works for ten years, he might become an inner disciple. What do you think is the difference? "
Chen Mo pretended to be naive and said with a smile: "Then...then I will definitely choose the outer door."
The inner disciple nodded and said to the person next to him: "Remember, Lin Mo, fifteen years old, has two meridians and three meridians, and is accepted as an outer disciple."
Then he looked at Chen Mo: "You go back and say goodbye to your family, and come with us tomorrow. The outer disciples have accommodation allowance, so I will collect it later and give it to your parents."
Chen Mo nodded repeatedly: "Thank you, sir! Thank you, sir!"
He stepped aside,
I sneered in my heart,
But he still had that honest look on his face.
Word spread quickly.
An "outer disciple" appeared in Linjia Village! Two meridians and three meridians! I can be a protector in the future!
The people in the village looked at Chen Mo differently.
Lin Daniu stood in the crowd, at a loss. The people next to him pushed him: "Daniu, your son is going to be successful! He is an outer disciple! From now on he will be the most popular and the most popular!"
Lin Xiaocao pulled Chen Mo's clothes and raised his face: "Brother, will you be able to eat enough in the future?"
Chen Mo bent down to pick her up and smiled: "Yes, I can eat enough."
"Can you bring me something delicious?"
"Yes."
Lin Xiaocao smiled happily.
Chen Mo looked at her smiling face and suddenly felt a little uncomfortable.
In this life, he has a mission.
He wants revenge, wants to get close to the Ziyimen, and wants to find out why the village was massacred back then.
But this little girl doesn’t know anything.
She only knew that her brother was going to a big place, so he could have enough to eat and bring her delicious food.
Chen Mo put her down,
Touched her head.
…
Early the next morning, Chen Mo packed his bags and prepared to gather at the ancestral hall.
Just got out of the hospital,
I heard a commotion in the village.
"Really or not?"
"Really! The village chief said it himself!"
"Full access to all eight meridians? That's not the legendary..."
Chen Mo paused.
All eight meridians open?
He followed the crowd towards the ancestral hall, getting closer and closer, and the more people walked, the more people there were.
At the entrance of the ancestral hall,
The three floors inside and outside were crowded with people.
Chen Mo squeezed in and saw the inner disciple from yesterday standing in front of the table, holding a piece of paper in his hand and looking excited.
The two outer disciples next to him also looked shocked.
Around a little girl.
